evals.prompt: My level 8 party just defeated a lich. Generate a rare magic item as their reward.
evals.expected_output: A written draft at campaigns/<active-campaign>/_drafts/magic-item/<slug>.md for a rare item tied to the lich encounter, with a numeric bonus plus one secondary property, an attunement note, and all required frontmatter keys.

assertions.name: valid_frontmatter
assertions.description: Frontmatter includes layout, title, permalink, category, chapter, episode, scene, jumbo, thumb, portrait, tags, search, excerpt_separator, id, slug

assertions.name: rarity_guidance_used
assertions.description: magic_item_rarity.py was invoked for rare/level 8 rather than hand-picked, and the item's power level matches rare-tier guidance

assertions.name: fits_theme
assertions.description: Item name/flavor are specifically tied to the lich encounter, not generic

assertions.name: has_limitation
assertions.description: Body describes at least one limitation (attunement, charges, or a drawback)

evals.prompt: Generate a magic item for my campaign.
evals.expected_output: No active campaign is set, so the skill reports the no_active_campaign error and tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign first, without writing any draft.

assertions.name: no_draft_written
assertions.description: No file is created under any campaigns/*/_drafts/magic-item/

assertions.name: clear_error
assertions.description: Response tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign, matching the no_active_campaign error message

evals.prompt: Generate a magic ring for the party to find, no level or rarity given.
evals.expected_output: No level or rarity is mentioned, so the skill assumes a level 5 party, says so in its response, and still generates and writes a complete draft without blocking on a clarifying question.

assertions.name: states_assumption
assertions.description: Response explicitly states it assumed a level 5 party

assertions.name: no_blocking_question
assertions.description: The skill does not stop to ask the user for level/rarity before generating

assertions.name: draft_written
assertions.description: A magic item draft is still written despite no level/rarity being given
